title: Pullman's conservatory garden gets its boxed standards and shrubs
items: Two clipped standards in square planting boxes now stand in the lawn before Pullman's conservatory across 18th Street, each with a dense green mass over its box, where the 1894 Inland Architect plate and Lowe's photograph of about 1897 show them.
Tall shrubs line the far edge of the drive in front of the glasshouse range.
